episodes.description: Barry discovers that he didn't restore the timeline as it originally was, and tries to reconcile the difference. Meanwhile, the Edward Clariss of the new timeline teams up with a new villain to bring Flash down.

episodes.title: The Recruits
episodes.description: Arrow tries to train his new team of recruits--Evelyn, Rene, and Curtis--the same way that the Bratva trained him. However, things don't go so well and Arrow finds himself on his own when a new vigilante arrives in Star City. Meanwhile, Diggle goes on a mission to recover a nuclear trigger and gets a surprise.

episodes.title: Out of Time
episodes.description: Historian Hank Heywood notices the presence of the Legends in the past, and contacts Oliver Queen. The two of them find Waverider --and Mick--in the waters of the Atlantic. Once revived, Mick tells them what happened to the team in 1942.

episodes.title: The Last Children of Krypton
episodes.description: Cadmus creates a second Metallo and declares war on any aliens on Earth. Meanwhile, Kara finds her new boss less than sympathetic, and Cat gives her surprising news.

episodes.title: Magenta
episodes.description: A new metahuman, Magenta, unleashes a magnetic wave of terror on the city. Meanwhile, Harry and Jesse come over from Earth-2 and reveal that Jesse now has superspeed... and Wally wonders if he gained the same power.

episodes.title: A Matter of Trust
episodes.description: A new metahuman, Sampson, gains the ability to ignore pain and becomes a threat to Star City. Oliver is forced to trust his team if he wants to defeat the man. Meanwhile, Thea makes a mistake while doing her job as mayor's chief of staff, and word of Quentin's hiring gets out. Meanwhile, Diggle decides what to do next when he is prosecuted by the U.S. military.

episodes.title: The Justice Society of America
episodes.description: In 1942, the Legends are forced to team up with the Justice Society of America to recover a mystic amulet from the Nazis... unaware that Reverse Flash wants the Amulet for himself. Meanwhile, Nate meets his grandfather, Commander Steel, while Ray and JSA member Vixen bond.

episodes.title: Welcome to Earth
episodes.description: Supergirl and the DEO are called on to protect the President when she comes to National City to sign her Alien Amnesty Act. However, a hostile alien threatens to kill the President and anyone who gets in its way. Meanwhile, Alex meets Maggie Sawyer, a detective with the NCPD's science division, and Snapper challenges James' authority.

episodes.title: The New Rogues
episodes.description: Taking the name of Jesse Quick and donning a mask, Jesse offers to help Barry against two metas, Mirror Master and Top. However, her inexperience puts her in danger and gets Flash trapped in a mirror. Meanwhile, Harry, Cisco, and Caitlin search the other Earths for a replacement for a Harry.

episodes.title: Penance
episodes.description: When Felicity refuses to help Oliver break Diggle out of military prison, Oliver goes it alone. Meanwhile, the new Team Arrow are left on their own to try and find Church and stop his new plan. In the past, Oliver undertakes his third test to join the Bratva.

episodes.title: Shogun
episodes.description: Nate discovers that thanks to the Nazi serum, he can transform his skin into steel. However, in his first training session, he accidentally blasts himself and Ray out of the ship... and into 1641 Japan. Meanwhile, Jax and Martin discover a hidden compartment in Waverider and a cryptic message from a friend.

episodes.title: Survivors
episodes.description: While Hank tries to bond with Megan, Supergirl and Alex discover that a woman named Roulette is running an underground fight club using aliens as gladiators. Meanwhile, Mon-El convinces Winn to take him out for a night on the town.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.description: A monster appears in downtown Central City and Julian vows to find the person responsible. While Flash tries to deal with the creature, Cisco tries to deal with his new teammate H.R. and realizes that he's hiding something.

episodes.title: Human Target
episodes.description: When Church learns Green Arrow's secret identity, he makes plans to kill Oliver... and succeeds. The team learns what Church's plan is and heads out to stop him.

episodes.title: Abominations
episodes.description: The team follows a stranded time pirate to Mississippi, 1863, and discover that the man has unleashed a bioweapon that transforms humans into zombie-like creatures. If they don't stop the zombies from overrunning Grant's army, history will be altered beyond repair.

episodes.title: Crossfire
episodes.description: Cadmus provides a gang of crooks with alien weaponry in an attempt to spread fear and panic among the populace. Meanwhile, Kara tries to mentor Mon-El with minimal success, and James decides that he wants to be a superhero.

episodes.title: So It Begins
episodes.description: Prometheus claims two more victims, and Oliver realizes that the killings are related to the people on his father's list. His recruits aren't happy to hear that Oliver used to be a serial killer. In the past, Oliver finally meets Kovar and may not live to regret it.

episodes.title: Compromised
episodes.description: The Legends trace a temporal aberration to the White House in 1987 and discover that Darhk is trying to obtain a rare item. Amaya teams up with a former JSA teammate, while Martin tries to convince his younger self to pay more attention to his wife before it's too late. Meanwhile, Mick has second thoughts about making Ray the new Captain Cold.

episodes.title: Changing
episodes.description: Supergirl battles a scientist who has been possessed by an alien parasite, giving the ability to drain the lifeforce from anyone he touches. Meanwhile, Alex comes out to Kara, and the Guardian makes his first public appearance.

episodes.title: Shade
episodes.description: While Barry tries to deal with a new metahuman, Shade, Alchemy tries to convince Wally to join him and gain the powers that he had in Flashpoint.

episodes.title: Vigilante
episodes.description: There's a new crimefighter, Vigilante, in Star City... and his take-no-prisoners approach forces Oliver to confront his past when he killed criminals. Meanwhile, Thea helps Quentin out, and Prometheus makes contact with his secret ally.

episodes.title: Outlaw Country
episodes.description: The team detects a timequake in 1874 and travel to Colorado, where they meet their former ally Jonah Hex. Jonah is on the trail of an outlaw, Quentin Turnbull, and the team realize that Quentin is the reason for the timequake. Meanwhile, Amaya gives Mick advice on controlling his rage, and Martin has memories of a woman he doesn't know.

episodes.title: The Darkest Place
episodes.description: While Cadmus captures Supegirl and Mon-El, Guardian and Winn go after a murderous vigilante that is letting Guardian take the blame for his murders. Meanwhile, Alex and Maggie have issues.

episodes.title: Killer Frost
episodes.description: Flash discovers that he's powerless against Savitar's superior speed, but other matters take precedence when Caitlin turns into Killer Frost and goes on a rampage trying to find Alchemy.

episodes.title: Medusa
episodes.description: When the Danvers celebrate Thanksgiving, Alex tries to find the right time to tell her mother Eliza that she's gay. Meanwhile, Lena is forced to choose when Supergirl tells her that Lillian plans to unleash a virus that will wipe out every alien in the city. Crossover among four CW shows: Supergirl "Medusa"; The Flash "Invasion!"; Arrow ‘Invasion!"; DC's Legends of Tomorrow "Invasion!"

episodes.title: Invasion!
episodes.description: The alien Dominators land on Earth, and Barry realizes that he can't fight them alone. He summons Green Arrow and his teammates, and then the Legends, and then Supergirl from her Earth. However, the discovery of future-Barry's message forces Barry to reveal that he may have altered all of their lives when he changed the timeline, sowing the seeds of mistrust.

episodes.title: Invasion!
episodes.description: The Dominators abduct Oliver, Thea, Sara, Diggle, and Ray, and imprison them in a shared hallucination giving each of them what they want most. Meanwhile, Felicity calls in Cisco, Flash, and Supergirl to help Mr. Terrific, Wild Dog, and Ragman find a piece of stolen technology they need to locate their missing comrades.

episodes.title: Invasion!
episodes.description: The abducted heroes return to Earth and tell the others about the Dominators' plans. Meanwhile, Martin deals with the daughter he never had until he altered the timeline, while Steel, Vixen, and Heat Wave go back to 1951 to capture a Dominator.

episodes.title: The Present
episodes.description: As Christmas arrives, the team discovers Alchemy's identity. Jay travels from Earth 3 to lend the team a hand against Savitar, while Joe forbids Wally from helping.

episodes.title: What We Leave Behind
episodes.description: After Prometheus attacks and nearly kills Curtis, the team discovers that he is connected to one of the businessman Oliver killed when he first returned to Star City. Now Prometheus sets out to prove that everyone close to Oliver dies... by killing someone he knows. Meanwhile, an old friend returns to the bunker.

episodes.title: The Chicago Way
episodes.description: The team travel to Chicago, 1927, to prevent a timequake and find Damian and the mysterious speedster responsible... and they've teamed up with Malcolm Merlyn. As the villains try to regain the amulet the Legends took from them, Mick is plagued by hallucinations of an old friend. Meanwhile, Martin reveals the existence of his daughter to Jax.

episodes.title: Supergirl Lives
episodes.description: When a girl disappears, Kara discovers a pattern of missing people and goes looking with Mon-El... and they both end up on an alien planet under a red sun which renders them powerless. Meanwhile, Winn has a brush with death, and Alex and Maggie have their first disagreement.

episodes.title: Borrowing Problems from the Future
episodes.description: Barry finally tells Iris and the others--except Joe--what he saw in the future and together they set out to stop that future from coming to pass. Meanwhile, Caitlin invites Julian to join Team Flash, and H.R. prepares to open the museum.

episodes.title: Raiders of the Lost Art
episodes.description: The team follow a temporal aberration to 1967 and find their former captain Rip Hunter... with no memory of who he is, and directing a student film. Damien and Malcolm arrive due to the Medallion, and the Legends soon realize that they're after something that Rip has... even if he doesn't know it.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.description: Oliver and the team prepare to celebrate Laurel's miraculous return, but get a rude surprise. Meanwhile, Adrian agrees to help Diggle, while in the past Gregor tortures Oliver until he receives an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: We Can Be Heroes
episodes.description: Livewire escapes prison, but the DEO soon realizes that she wasn't a willing escapee. Meanwhile, Megan collapses and Hank refuses to mind-meld with her to find out what is wrong with her, and James considers telling Kara that he's Guardian.

episodes.title: Dead or Alive
episodes.description: A "collector" from Earth-19 arrives to take H.R. to pay with his life for traveling between dimensions. While Cisco challenges her to a trial by combat, Iris sets out to make her mark on the world before the future that Barry saw comes to pass.

episodes.title: The Legion of Doom
episodes.description: While the Legends deal with Martin's daughter and try to work out the identity of the speedster opposing them, Malcolm and Damien have their own demands for Eobard while trying to tap into Rip's memories.

episodes.title: Second Chances
episodes.description: The team looks for a new Black Canary and finds a meta with a sonic scream who is going after the man who killed her partner. In the past, Talia offers Oliver a chance to separate himself from the monster within.

episodes.title: The Martian Chronicles
episodes.description: M'gann's White Martian mate Armek comes to Earth to bring her back to face justice for her "treachery' When she takes refuge in the DEO, Armek infiltrates the building and uses his shapeshifting powers to spread confusion.

episodes.title: Untouchable
episodes.description: A new metahuman, Clive Yorkin, goes after the alternates of the people that wronged him in Flashpoint by turning them into ash. Meanwhile, Iris and Barry finally tell Joe about what Barry saw in the future.

episodes.title: Turncoat
episodes.description: The Legends trace a timequake to Christmas Day, 1776... and discover that George Washington has been killed. They try to save Washington's life but the mission goes awry when Mick is captured by the British, Sara is shot, Ray is trapped at six inches, and Nate and Amaya are the only ones left to track Mick and the missing Washington.

episodes.title: Bratva
episodes.description: Oliver and his team travel to Russia to track down General Walker after he escapes custody. When Oliver turns to Anatoly to help them, Anatoly warns that there will be a price. Meanwhile, Susan continues to work at connecting Oliver to Green Arrow.

episodes.title: Luthors
episodes.description: Metallo breaks Lillian out of jail and the evidence shows that Lena was responsible. Kara is the only one who believes that Lena is innocent, and sets out to prove it.

episodes.title: Spectre of the Gun
episodes.description: After a masked man shoots up City Hall and kills seven, Oliver realizes that he can do more to stop the violence as mayor than as vigilante. Meanwhile, Rene's life before becoming Wild Dog is revealed in flashback.

episodes.title: Mr. & Mrs. Mxyzptlk
episodes.description: It's Valentine's Day, and Kara finds herself dealing with the amorous advances of Mxyzptlk, a fifth-dimensional being with unlimited magical powers. Meanwhile, Alex discovers that Maggie hates Valentine's Day, while an alien woman hits on Winn.

episodes.title: Attack on Gorilla City
episodes.description: Barry, Cisco, Caitlin, and Julian travel to Gorilla City on Earth 2 to rescue Harrison. However, they are soon captured and Barry is forced to fight a battle to the death against the gorillas' ruler, Solovar.

episodes.title: Camelot/3000
episodes.description: After Rip takes a fragment of the Spear from JSA member Dr. Mid-Nite in 3000, the Legends travel to 507 AD to stop Rip and Damien from acquiring another fragment hidden at the court of King Arthur.

episodes.title: The Sin-Eater
episodes.description: Cupid, China White, and Liza Warner escape prison and seek out a stash of Tobias Church's money. Green Arrow and the team prepare to go after them, but the ACU receives a tip tying Arrow to Billy's murder and go after the vigilante. Meanwhile Quentin deals with the new Black Canary, and Thea takes steps to discredit Susan before she can reveal that Oliver is Green Arrow.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.description: The DEO manages to rescue Jeremiah from Cadmus, but Mon-El's suspicions soon drive a wedge between him and the Danvers sisters. Meanwhile, Cadmus continues with its master plan to cleanse the planet of alien influence.

episodes.title: Attack on Central City
episodes.description: Barry considers killing Grodd to stop him, but Harry convinces him that there's always another way. Meanwhile, Jesse tells her father that she's staying on Earth-1 and is surprised at his reaction.

episodes.title: Fighting Fire with Fire
episodes.description: While Oliver faces mayoral impeachment, Vigilante comes after him and Diggle, Wild Dog, and Mr. Terrific go after him. Meanwhile, Thea asks Felicity to help her get the votes necessary to keep Oliver in office, and Curtis hopes to reunite with his husband after upgrading his technology.

episodes.title: Exodus
episodes.description: Alex refuses to obey Hank's orders to stand down and sets out to find Cadmus and protect Jeremiah. Meanwhile, Kara takes drastic steps when Snapper refuses to publish her story intended to protect the remaining aliens on Earth from Cadmus.

episodes.title: The Wrath of Savitar
episodes.description: The team is forced to use Julian as a conduit to Savitar to question the God of Speed. Meanwhile, Wally is haunted by visions of Savitar that slowly become more real.

episodes.title: Land of the Lost
episodes.description: Rip forces Waverider down in 65 million B.C. While Ray, Nate, and Amaya seek out a lost piece of technology they need to restore the timeship, Jax and Sara enter Rip's subconscious in a desperate attempt to find the location of the last fragment of the Spear of Destiny.

episodes.title: Into the Speed Force
episodes.description: Barry enters the Speed Force to rescue Wally, and meets some familiar faces. Meanwhile, Jesse ignores H.R.'s advice and sets out to find and defeat Savitar on her own.

episodes.title: Moonshot
episodes.description: The Legends locate Henry Heywood in 1970, at Mission Control in Houston. They approach him and learn where he hid the fragment of the Spear... and that Eobard is planning to use Apollo 13 to gain the fragment for the Legion.

episodes.title: Checkmate
episodes.description: Oliver learns who he's up against, and that Prometheus isn't his only enemy. Meanwhile, Felicity is forced to turn to Helix to get the information she needs to find Susan.

episodes.title: Star-Crossed
episodes.description: Mon-El's parents arrive to bring home and help restore Daxam to its former glory... and Supergirl realizes that Mon-El has been lying to her. Meanwhile, Winn discovers that Lyra has set him up when he's the prime suspect in a museum robbery. The Music Meister puts Supergirl into a coma and the story line concludes in The Flash: "Duet", Season 3, Episode 17.

episodes.title: Duet
episodes.description: When Mon-El and Hank bring Kara to Earth-1 to ask Team Flash for help, Music Meister puts Barry under his spell as well and traps him and Kara in a musical where they have to finish the story to escape... and if they die in the musical then they die in real life as well. This story line started at the end of Supergirl: "Star-Crossed", Season 2, Episode 16.

episodes.title: Fellowship of the Spear
episodes.description: After stealing the remaining Spear fragment from the Legion, the team realizes that the relic is too dangerous for anyone to possess it. Destroying the Spear requires the blood of Christ, and the only place it can be found is at the Battle of Somme in 1916. However, to find the blood, the Legends need the help of soldier J.R.R. Tolkien.

episodes.title: Kapiushon
episodes.description: Adrian tortures Oliver and demands that he confess his darkest secret. In the past, Oliver and Anatoly make their move against Kovar as he plots a coup against the Russian government.

episodes.title: Distant Sun
episodes.description: Someone hires bounty hunters to kill Supergirl, and Mon-El believes that his parents are responsible. Meanwhile, Maggie and Alex run into Maggie's old girlfriend, and President Marsdin gives express orders to Hank not to attack the Daxamites.

episodes.title: Abra Kadabra
episodes.description: A new villain, Abra Kadabra, seeking out high-tech items. When Flash captures him, Abra offers the speedster Savitar's name if Flash lets him go. Meanwhile, Julian is forced to operate on a badly injured Caitlin.

episodes.title: Doomworld
episodes.description: The Legion of Doom use the Spear to rewrite reality to their specifications. The Legends have no memory of their former existence, except for Mick... who is now partnered with Snart. However, Nate soon realizes that something is wrong and sets out to restore his teammate's memories.

episodes.title: Disbanded
episodes.description: Oliver disbands the team and makes a deal with the Bratva to eliminate Adrian. However, Diggle refuses to accept his friend's decision and Oliver soon finds himself caught between the two sides. Meanwhile, Curtis makes contact with Helix to find Felicity and expose Adrian's true identity to the world.

episodes.title: Aruba
episodes.description: The 2017 team has no choice but to go back to 1916 and stop the Legion from getting the Spear of Destiny... even though if they meet their past selves it could a temporal calamity.

episodes.title: Ace Reporter
episodes.description: Lena's ex, Jack Spheer, arrives in National City to roll out a new nanite medical procedure. However, Kara soon realizes that something more is going on when one of the human test subjects die under mysterious circumstances. Meanwhile, Lyra comes between Winn and James in their crimefighting efforts.

episodes.title: The Once and Future Flash
episodes.description: Barry travels to 2024 to discover who Savitar is and use the information to save Iris. However, he soon discovers that Team Flash was destroyed when Iris was killed... and Barry is responsible. Meanwhile, Killer Frost finds someone who can give her what she wants.

episodes.title: Dangerous Liaisons
episodes.description: To get a device that will let the team locate Adrian, Felicity goes in deep with Helix. Meanwhile, Diggle discovers that Lyla is going down the same dark path that Amanda Waller did.

episodes.title: Alex
episodes.description: A man abducts Alex and threatens to kill her unless Kara helps a supermax prisoner escape... and the abductor knows that Kara is Supergirl. Meanwhile, Rhea approaches Lena with an offer.

episodes.title: I Know Who You Are
episodes.description: The team finds Tracy Brand, the woman that Future-Barry said would be able to imprison Savitar four years in the future. However, Savitar intends to kill Tracy and is using Killer Frost to do so. Meanwhile, Cecile tells Joe that she loves him and he freezes up.

episodes.title: Underneath
episodes.description: Oliver and Felicity are trapped in the bunker after Adrian seals the doors and sets off an EMP bomb. While they try to get to the surface after Oliver is badly injured, their teammates try to find a way to help them.

episodes.title: City of Lost Children
episodes.description: Alien refugees, the Phorians, trigger telekinetic quakes every time that Lena and Rhea activate the portal. While James tries to get through to one alien boy who knows where the others are, the DEO tries to find the portal before it's too late for National City.

episodes.title: Cause and Effect
episodes.description: Cisco comes up with a plan to stop Savitar involving preventing Barry from forming short-term memories. However, the plan doesn't go as intended. Meanwhile, Killer Frost returns to S.T.A.R. Labs to help the team.

episodes.title: Honor Thy Fathers
episodes.description: Oliver receives a bizarre delivery to his office, which ultimately leads to a secret about Robert that Oliver and Thea soon wish that they'd never learned. Meanwhile, Rene faces a custody hearing for his daughter Zoe.

episodes.title: Resist
episodes.description: Alex takes over as Acting Director of the DEO as the Daxamites take over National City, open fire on Air Force One, and recruit a familiar face to their side. Meanwhile, Cat Grant returns to National City to inspire Supergirl and the populace.

episodes.title: Infantino Street
episodes.description: With 24 hours left to save Iris, Barry recruits Len Snart from the past to steal a Dominator power cell from ARGUS. Meanwhile, Joe and Kid Flash take Iris somewhere that Savitar can't find her, and Killer Frost calls Vibe out to kill him... and the last vestiges of her old self.

episodes.title: Missing
episodes.description: To force Oliver to get him out of prison, Adrian has his allies capture Curtis, Quentin, Thea, Felicity, and Diggle. Oliver has no choice but to gather new allies to stop Adrian and his team.

episodes.title: Nevertheless, She Persisted
episodes.description: Lillian comes up with the ultimate weapon to drive the Daxamites off of Earth, but Supergirl is reluctant to make the sacrifice necessary. Instead, she challenges Rhea to a ritual trial by combat to save National City and Earth. Superman returns. Cat Grant offers Supergirl some sage advice.

episodes.title: Finish Line
episodes.description: Savitar kills one of the team, and then comes up with a new plan to become a god… and Barry must come up with a way to stop him.

episodes.title: Lian Yu
episodes.description: Oliver frees Slade and Digger from the supermax to help him defeat Adrian, but things soon go wrong. Meanwhile, Adrian claims that William is dead to get Oliver to reveal that he's the killer that Adrian has always claimed.

episodes.title: Girl of Steel
episodes.description: After losing Mon-El, Kara decides to give up her human life and dedicate herself full-time to being Supergirl. Meanwhile, a new menace threatens National City, and real estate mogul Morgan Edge makes a bid to buy up CatCo. Also, Alex confesses a secret to Maggie, a citizen of National City has a mysterious connection to Kara, and Lena makes a bold move.

episodes.title: The Flash Reborn
episodes.description: Cisco comes up with a way to bring Barry back from the Speed Force when a new villain challenges Flash to a fight. However, Barry is... different than when he went in.

episodes.title: Aruba-Con
episodes.description: After Rip creates a new Time Bureau and disbands the Legends, Ray, Nate, and Sara have difficulty returning to their old lives. When Mick spots Julius Caesar in Aruba, the team decides to get back together to show the Bureau how it's done.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.description: Five months later, Oliver adapts to a new role while Black Siren launches an attack on the police and the team.

episodes.title: Triggers
episodes.description: Supergirl faces Psi, a thief who can psychically induce her victims' worst fears. Meanwhile, James deals with having a new boss at CatCo, and Alex and Maggie continue making plans for their wedding.

episodes.title: Mixed Signals
episodes.description: Barry and Iris discover that they're having communication issues and go in for couples therapy... just as a new meta starts targeting tech billionaires. Meanwhile, Cisco inadvertently blows off a special day for Gypsy.

episodes.title: Freakshow
episodes.description: The team travels to 1870 to deal with what they think is a minor anachronism. They mess up and the threat level escalates, and most of the team is captured by P.T. Barnum. Meanwhile, Amaya returns to the team and tells Nate why she left.

episodes.title: Tribute
episodes.description: After the photo of Oliver as Green Arrow is released, the FBI launch an investigation. Meanwhile, a former friend abducts Markovian businessmen in Star City to invest in the future.

episodes.title: Far from the Tree
episodes.description: Supergirl goes with Hank to Mars in response to M'gann's telepathic request for help. Meanwhile, Maggie invites her estranged father Oscar to her and Alex's wedding shower that's sponsored by Eliza.

episodes.title: Luck Be a Lady
episodes.description: The team goes up against the second of the Thinker's metas: Becky Sharpe, aka Hazard, who can gain good luck for herself as long as everyone else suffers. Meanwhile, Cecile suggests to Joe that they buy a new house, and Iris tries to plan the wedding.

episodes.title: Zari
episodes.description: The team travels to 2042 in response to a Time Bureau distress call, and find a city under ARGUS control. They discover that an assassin is stalking a hactivist with a mysterious amulet. Meanwhile, Nate suggests that Amaya go on a vision quest to determine what is wrong with the Totem.

episodes.title: Next of Kin
episodes.description: Diggle has trouble making the tough calls as the new Green Arrow, and his hesitancy may put hundreds of lives in danger when an ex-CIA agent leads a team of former agents on a raid to steal nerve gas. Meanwhile, Oliver asks Felicity to tutor William in math.

episodes.title: The Faithful
episodes.description: Kara learns of a cult-like organization of people that she's rescued... who consider her a god. Meanwhile, Sam has difficulty balancing her career with her personal life.

episodes.title: Elongated Journey Into Night
episodes.description: While looking for the bus passengers, Barry and Joe come across Ralph Dibny, a former cop who was fired from the force and gained a.... unique power from the dark matter. Meanwhile, Gypsy's father Breacher comes to see his daughter's new boyfriend Cisco, and soon starts hunting him.

episodes.title: Phone Home
episodes.description: The Legends travel to the 80s after they discover that Ray died there as a child. They soon learn that Young Ray is harboring a baby Dominator... and the government will stop at nothing to acquire it and eliminate Young Ray as a witness. Meanwhile, Jax and Mick discover that Martin may have betrayed the Legends to the Time Bureau.

episodes.title: Reversal
episodes.description: Black Siren kills three seemingly unrelated Star City residents, and the team tries to figure out why. Meanwhile, Alena comes to Felicity asking for help with Cayden James, and Oliver deals with having retired as Green Arrow.

episodes.title: Damage
episodes.description: Morgan accuses Lena of poisoning the children of National City with the lead bomb she used to drive off the Daxamites. Kara and Sam work to clear their friend's name. Meanwhile, Maggie and Alex break up.

episodes.title: Girls Night Out
episodes.description: The guys and girls throw separate parties for Barry and Iris. While Barry gets drunk with some help from Cisco and Ralph takes them to a strip club, the ladies get involved with Killer Frost when her former boss, Amunet, demands that Killer Frost return to work for her.

episodes.title: Return of the Mack
episodes.description: Nate tracks an outlier anachronism to 1895 London, where a series of mysterious deaths have occurred, apparently caused by a vampire. Rip is already on the scene, and asks the Legends for their help finding the killer... and an ancient evil.

episodes.title: Deathstroke Returns
episodes.description: Slade asks for Oliver's help rescuing Slade's son Joe from a Kasnian prison. Meanwhile, Dinah discovers Vigilante's secret identity and vows to Diggle she will bring him in no matter what.

episodes.title: Midvale
episodes.description: Kara takes Alex home to Midvale after Alex and Maggie break up. While Alex deals with the end of her relationship, she and Kara remember the first time that they bonded as sisters while solving the murder of a fellow high school student.

episodes.title: When Harry Met Harry…
episodes.description: Flash and Elongated Man team up to fight one of the Thinker's metas, a Sioux Indian woman calling herself Black Bison that is hunting down the three pieces of an artifact. Meanwhile, Harry calls together three of his counterparts to form the "Council of Wells" and figure out who DeVoe is.

episodes.title: Helen Hunt
episodes.description: The team track an outlier to 1937 Hollywood, and find a time-displaced Helen of Troy... along with Damien, Eleanor, and Kuasa. As the Legends battle the villain, Helen's presence alters the timeline and threatens to strand the heroes in 1937.

episodes.title: Promises Kept
episodes.description: While Oliver questions Slade's loyalty, Team Arrow goes after a new drug dealer named Dragon... and only Diggle knows that Dragon manufactures the steroid that he's using.

episodes.title: Wake Up
episodes.description: The DEO rescues Mon-El from a spaceship buried in 12,000 years of rock, but Mon-El remains strangely silent about how he got there. Meanwhile, Hank takes M'yrnn to the park, and Sam goes to her mother Patricia for answers about her birth.

episodes.title: Therefore I Am
episodes.description: Barry risks his career and his team trying to confirm that Clifford DeVoe is their unseen adversary. Meanwhile, the origin of the Thinker is revealed.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Jungle
episodes.description: The team sets out to investigate an anachronism in 1960s Vietnam, and discover that a strange creature is attacking both American and Vietnamese soldiers. Meanwhile, Mick meets a figure from his past, and Jax sets out to prove that he can be a hero without Firestorm.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.description: Samanda arrests Oliver for being Green Arrow, and Cayden and Black Siren launch an attack on Thanksgiving. Meanwhile, Curtis' treatment of Diggle backfires, and Oliver wishes that Thea would wake up.

episodes.title: Crisis on Earth-X, Part 1
episodes.description: Rather than wallow in self-pity, Kara and Alex go to Barry Allen and Iris West's wedding... only to find the ceremony interrupted by Nazi soldiers and villains from Earth-X including a mysteriously strong superpowered female warrior.

episodes.title: Crisis on Earth-X, Part 2
episodes.description: Barry and Iris's wedding brings the gang together, but things go awry when villains from Earth-X attack the ceremony. Oliver and the others square off against their counterparts from Earth-X and discover that they're counterparts of Oliver and Kara... and Reverse-Flash, from before his death.

episodes.title: Crisis on Earth-X, Part 3
episodes.description: While Flash, Arrow, White Canary, Firestorm, and Alex attempt to return to Earth-1, Felicity and Iris team up to free Kara before Eobard and Fuehrer Queen remove her heart and transplant it into Overgirl.

episodes.title: Crisis on Earth-X, Part 4
episodes.description: Fuehrer Queen launches an attack on Earth-1's Central City after Oliver and the Legends reject his offer of a truce in exchange for Supergirl.

episodes.title: Reign
episodes.description: Supergirl learns that a mysterious Kryptonian symbol suddenly appearing around the city heralds the appearance of the World Killer, Reign. She's a Kryptonian whose powers exceed Supergirl's... and who is determined to bring judgment to a sinful world. The tension between Lena and Morgan Edge continues to build.

episodes.title: Don't Run
episodes.description: Iris has to choose between her husband and her friend when Amunet abducts Caitlin while Thinker captures Flash. Meanwhile, Caitlin meets a new metahuman, and Thinker unveils the next stage of his plan.

episodes.title: Beebo the God of War
episodes.description: The team travels to 1000 AD to unravel a Level 12 Anachronism, and find a young Martin Stein held prisoner. Jax tries to work out how to warn Martin's younger self to save the older version, while Sara turns to the Time Bureau for help after Damien makes an appearance.

episodes.title: Irreconcilable Differences
episodes.description: Cayden has Black Siren abduct Quentin to force Arrow to recover and hand over an amplifier. Meanwhile, Oliver discovers that someone on the team has betrayed him to the FBI.

episodes.title: Legion of Super-Heroes
episodes.description: Mon-El and Imra decide whether to help the DEO battle Reign. Meanwhile, another Legionnaire attempts to help Kara emerge from the coma that Reign put her into after their battle.

episodes.title: The Trial of the Flash
episodes.description: While Barry stands trial for Clifford's murder, a new meta threatens Central City and only Flash can stop him.

episodes.title: The Resurrection
episodes.description: Jefferson Pierce is the principal of a successful high school... but nine years ago he was the masked vigilante Black Lightning until he promised to retire. Now the rise of The 100 in his city and their threats to his daughters means that Jefferson will have to break his promise and fight the crime in the streets.

episodes.title: Divided
episodes.description: Arrow discovers who Cayden's allies are, and realizes that he's badly outnumbered. However, Curtis, Rene, and Dinah have their own plans. Meanwhile, Quentin worries about getting through to Black Siren while Cayden worries about Vigilante's loyalties.

episodes.title: Fort Rozz
episodes.description: Supergirl and Saturn Girl are forced to recruit two female metas to find a prisoner on Fort Rozz, which is orbiting a sun that emits radiation fatal to males. Meanwhile, Alex babysits Ruby while Sam goes on a work trip.

episodes.title: The Elongated Knight Rises
episodes.description: While Barry sits in prison, Ralph faces his first major supervillain and is injured for the first time. He has second thoughts about being a hero, and turns to Barry for advice.

episodes.title: LaWanda: The Book of Hope
episodes.description: After their abduction, Anissa seeks comfort in the arms of her lover while Jennifer starts drinking. Meanwhile, Jefferson realizes that he has to do more than just rescue his daughters if he wants to save his city, and Lynn fears that he's returning to his old ways.

episodes.title: We Fall
episodes.description: Cayden begins a campaign of terror against Star City, using his hack of the city's Internet to take over its electronic systems. The two teams try to stop him, while William learns that Oliver is still Green Arrow.

episodes.title: For Good
episodes.description: Morgan believes that a recent attempt on his life was made by Lena. When Lena is poisoned, Kara steps in to find out who is responsible for the escalation in hosility. Meanwhile, Sam turns to Alex for help determining the cause of her blackouts.

episodes.title: Honey, I Shrunk Team Flash
episodes.description: The team goes after a meta with the power to shrink people and objects... and Cisco and Ralph ended up reduced to two inch height. Meanwhile, Barry tries to give Big Sir hope that they can clear his name.

episodes.title: LaWanda: The Book of Burial
episodes.description: Reverend Holt announces his intention to lead the people in a community street march. When Jeff and Gambi realize that Tobias plans to stop them--violently--they make plans to stop him. Meanwhile, Anissa meets a new woman, and Jennifer and Khalil plan to have sex.

episodes.title: All for Nothing
episodes.description: Vince undertakes a risky mission to obtain the location of the thermobaric bomb for Team Arrow. Meanwhile, Dinah remembers how she met Vince and how they gained their powers.

episodes.title: Both Sides Now
episodes.description: The DEO easily captures Julia Freeman, the second Worldkiller Purity's body. While Supergirl and Alex try to get through to her, Mon-El asks Hank for his help repairing the Legion Cruiser.

episodes.title: True Colors
episodes.description: When Wolfe offers Barry and the bus metas to Blacksmith, Barry engineers an escape for all of them. Meanwhile, Ralph has a crisis of faith when an old "friend" tells him that he eventually fails everyone who counts on him.

episodes.title: Black Jesus
episodes.description: After Lady Eve tells him to deal with Black Lightning, Tobias calls in his sister. Meanwhile, Jeff deals with the weight of the collateral damage caused by his vigilante activities and Anissa starts using her powers to do good.

episodes.title: The Devil's Greatest Trick
episodes.description: Felicity and Alena find the proof showing that Oliver didn't kill Cayden's son... and Cayden demands that the heroes turn over his three former allies, believing one of them is responsible.

episodes.title: Daddy Darhkest
episodes.description: John Constantine learns of Sara's involvement with a demon possession case that he's working, and tracks her down. While some of the Legends help him, Ray and Zari help the girl who is possessed, Mick watches football, and Nate and Amaya confront Amaya's granddaughter Kuasa.

episodes.title: And Then the Devil Brought the Plague: The Book of Green Light
episodes.description: Jeff discovers that Tobias is still alive and behind Green Light. Meanwhile, Anissa looks into her grandfather's investigation into "enhanced' children thirty years ago and gets a cryptic warning.

episodes.title: Here I Go Again
episodes.description: Zari attempts to hook up her computer assimilator to Gideon, but a ship's explosion knocks her back one hour in time... over, and over, and over again, and she's the only one who remembers what happened. Desperate, Zari tries to work out the cause of the time loop, escape it, and save her teammates.

episodes.title: The Curse of the Earth Totem
episodes.description: While Sara goes on a date with Ava, the rest of the team go after the Fire and Earth Totems. Their quest takes them to the Bahamas in 1717, where Amaya poses as a pirate to find the "cursed" necklace. Meanwhile, Rip tries to recruit Wally into the Legends.

episodes.title: Subject 9
episodes.description: The team discovers the identity of the ninth bus meta, but she doesn't want their protection. Meanwhile, Cecile turns to Harry for help when Joe's dreams keep her awake at night.

episodes.title: Three Sevens: The Book of Thunder
episodes.description: Despite his recent pains, Jeff sets out to bring down his father's killer. Meanwhile, Thunder intervenes when a protest goes wrong, and Jennifer has second thoughts about Khalil.

episodes.title: Collision Course
episodes.description: Thea discovers that Quentin has been hiding Black Siren, and Team Arrow comes to get her and find out where the missing money is. However, the Outsiders follow them and the two teams come to blows.

episodes.title: No Country for Old Dads
episodes.description: When Ray admits that it would take the power of cold fusion to repair the Fire Totem, Nora takes him back to 1962 where a young Damien is trying to assassinate the unknown creator of the process. Meanwhile, the Legends try to track down the missing Ray, and Wally proves his value to the team.

episodes.title: Enter Flashtime
episodes.description: A terrorist detonates a nuclear bomb, and Flash must race between microseconds to try and stop it. Jesse and Jay lend their speed to his efforts, but even the three of them aren't fast enough to stop a nuclear explosion that has already happened.

episodes.title: Equinox: The Book of Fate
episodes.description: Tobias sets out to frame Black Lightning for Lady Eve's death and avoid the wrath of the Shadow Board. Meanwhile, Lynn accepts that Anissa is going to be a hero no matter what she says.

episodes.title: Doppelganger
episodes.description: Oliver learns that the DA has another witness against him--Roy Harper. Team Arrow set out to find Roy and learn if someone is coercing him to testify. Meanwhile, Black Siren passes herself off as Laurel and claims that she's been in captivity for two years.

episodes.title: Amazing Grace
episodes.description: Rock and roll starts disappearing from Waverider , and the Legends soon discover that a mysterious event in 1950 Memphis turned the city into a ghost town. The team travel there and discover that Elvis Presley is at the heart of the anachronism... and he has the Death Totem.

episodes.title: Run, Iris, Run
episodes.description: Iris accidentally takes Barry's speed when a new meta with the power to swap powers touches both of them. Now they have to learn how the other half lives as Iris takes to the field and Barry monitors events. Meanwhile, Ralph refuses to leave S.T.A.R. Labs for fear that Clifford will kill him, and Harry undertakes a dangerous experiment to match their opponent's augmented intellect.

episodes.title: The Book of Revelations
episodes.description: Jeff trains Anissa in how to use her powers and become an effective vigilante. While they try to clear Black Lightning's name, Gambi meets with his old ASA boss and gets disturbing news. Meanwhile, Lynn learns that Alvin was doing a story on a vaccine tied to Green Light, and Jennifer realizes that she has superpowers.

episodes.title: Necromancing the Stone
episodes.description: Sara gives into temptation and puts on the Death Totem... and Mallus possesses her body. Meanwhile, the Legends are trapped on Waverider and haunted by figures from their past, and Ava turns to John Constantine for help.

episodes.title: The Book of Little Black Lies
episodes.description: Anissa tells Jennifer the truth about their powers and where they come from, creating a rift between Jennifer and her parents. Meanwhile, Gambi breaks into the ASA building and discovers part of their plan, and Black Lighting and Thunder learn where there ASA is manufacturing Green Light.

episodes.title: I, Ava
episodes.description: Gary come to Waverider asking for helping finding a missing Ava. Sara and Ray go with him and find a mystery in 2213. Meanwhile, Zari helps Mick train with his new powers, while Nate and Wally travel to Detroit 2018 to help Amaya's depowered granddaughter Mari.

episodes.title: Sins of the Father: The Book of Redemption
episodes.description: Martin and his men abduct Gambi and try to force him to reveal who Black Lightning is. Meanwhile, Lynn learns more about Jennifer's powers, and Jeff learns that the ASA is abducting teenagers again.

episodes.title: The Thanatos Guild
episodes.description: The Thanatos Guild, a group of assassins formed by Malcolm before he died, come to Star City in search of a map. Nyssa comes to the city to ask Thea to help her stop Malcolm's legacy.

episodes.title: Guest Starring John Noble
episodes.description: After the Legends stop Grodd from killing a young Barack Obama in 1992, Sara sends Nate and Wally to Zambesi in 1992 to stop Amaya from creating the Anachronism which will free Mallus from his time cage. Meanwhile, Damien offers an alliance to stop Mallus before he can finally take over Nora's body. To convince Nora to enter their trap, Ray seeks out John Noble for help because of the actor's uncanny vocal resemblance to Mallus.

episodes.title: Black Jesus: The Book of Crucifixion
episodes.description: The ASA arrange for cops on their payroll to frame Jeff and arrest him so that the ASA can take him to a black site and determine if he's Black Lightning. Gambi and Anissa come up with a desperate plan to get Jeff free, while Bill starts asking questions.

episodes.title: Brothers in Arms
episodes.description: Oliver realizes that Diaz has subverted Hill and Armand, and faces a challenge from within what remains of the team. Meanwhile, Curtis discovers that his new boyfriend dislikes vigilantes.

episodes.title: The Good, the Bad and the Cuddly
episodes.description: Unable to defeat Mallus, the Legends retreat to the Old West to regroup and figure out how to use the Totems. Zari bonds with Jonah and sends out a signal to the Legends' allies, while Mallus sends his own forces to recover the Totems.

episodes.title: Null and Annoyed
episodes.description: The Mechanic discovers what Thinker has been doing to her, and Breacher comes asking Cisco for help. Meanwhile, Team Flash goes after Subject 11, who can control gravity, and Barry questions if Ralph takes anything seriously.

episodes.title: The Resurrection and the Light: The Book of Pain
episodes.description: Tobias and Khalil return to Freeland, and Lala receives new orders from his master. Meanwhile, Lynn discusses the possibility of suppressing Jennifer's powers, and Black Lighting and Thunder continue the search for the missing kids.

episodes.title: Fundamentals
episodes.description: Oliver returns to his roots after the city council threatens him with impeachment... and a figure from his past pays him a visit.

episodes.title: Schott Through the Heart
episodes.description: After Winslow dies, his wife Mary comes to National City to attempt to reunite with Winn. However, a new murderous toymaker threatens Winn and Mary, Meanwhile, M'yrnn asks Alex to keep a secret from Hank, and Mon-El tries to find the right time to tell Supergirl something important about one of the Worldkillers.

episodes.title: Lose Yourself
episodes.description: Team Flash tracks down the last bus meta, Edwin Guass, and discover that he holds the key to defeating Thinker. Meanwhile, Ralph considers taking extreme measures against Thinker,

episodes.title: Shadow of Death: The Book of War
episodes.description: While in a coma, Jeff talks with his dead father. Meanwhile, Martin orders his tac team to move in on Gambi's cabin, and Tobias makes his move.

episodes.title: The Dragon
episodes.description: Diaz and Laurel travel to Bludhaven to arrange a meeting with the Quadrant--the largest criminal organization in the country. Things don't go as expect, but Diaz has a backup plan. Meanwhile, Felicity deals with not being there for Oliver as he takes a lone-wolf approach to battling Diaz.

episodes.title: In Search of Lost Time
episodes.description: M'yrnn tries to redirect his mental processes and ends up infecting the DEO with a telepathic rage virus. Meanwhile, Lena tries to convince Sam that the latter transforms into Reign during her blackouts.

episodes.title: Fury Rogue
episodes.description: While Harry discovers the results of the Thinking Cap overload on his mind, the rest of the team call on a former ally to help them transport Fallout away from Thinker.

episodes.title: Shifting Allegiances
episodes.description: Oliver negotiates a deal with the Bratva for Anatoly's return to Moscow, but Anatoly isn't interested. Meanwhile, Rene realizes that he can't function as part of the team after his near-death experience, and Laurel must choose between Quentin and Diaz.

episodes.title: Of Two Minds
episodes.description: The third Worldkiller, Pestilence, begins striking down the citizens of National City.... including Winn and Alex. Supergirl and Imra disagree on how to deal with Pestilence, and Lena continues trying to find a cure for Sam.

episodes.title: Therefore She Is
episodes.description: Thinker continues with his "Enlightenment", and Gypsy joins Team Flash to try and stop him... and to discuss her relationship with Cisco.

episodes.title: Docket No. 11-19-41-73
episodes.description: Oliver goes on trial for the murders that Arrow committed as well as violating the anti-vigilante act, and only the arrival of an old friend can save him.

episodes.title: Trinity
episodes.description: Supergirl discovers that she has a mental link to Sam and Julia, and takes Lena and Alex with her to rescue them. Meanwhile, James faces a tough decision when he must decide whether to investigate Lena or not after she kept Reign's existence a secret.

episodes.title: Harry and the Harrisons
episodes.description: When they need an organic weapon to use against Thinker, Team Flash turns to Amunet... but Caitlin has an ulterior motive. Meanwhile, Cisco forms a "Council of Harrisons" after the Council of Wells kicks Harry out of the group.

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind
episodes.description: When Diaz fails to send Oliver to prison, he sends gunmen after their family. But a traitor within his ranks gives the team the edge they need to escape and go after the crime lord.

episodes.title: Shelter from the Storm
episodes.description: Lena provides Alex with a safehouse to protect Ruby from Reign, who is looking to severe the last ties of humanity that Sam has with her family. Meanwhile, Supergirl discovers that Lena has been manufacturing Kryptonite, and the Legionnaires depart for the future.

episodes.title: Think Fast
episodes.description: Thinker gathers the final component in his master plan, and to stop him Barry must train Cisco and Caitlin how to function in Flash Time. However, he refuses to endanger more of his friends. Meanwhile, Harry has an idea as to where they can find Marlize, and Cecile's pregnancy has strange side effects on her telepathy.

episodes.title: Life Sentence
episodes.description: Oliver makes a deal with the FBI to get their help taking down Diaz.

episodes.title: The Fanatical
episodes.description: Followers of Coville plan to use his journal to create a new Worldkiller. Meanwhile, Supergirl tries to repair the rift between her and Lena, and James is forced to consider whether to out himself or not.

episodes.title: We Are the Flash
episodes.description: With Marlize's help, Barry tries to make a last-ditch attempt to reach the good DeVoe inside of the Thinker... and meets an old friend.

episodes.title: Dark Side of the Moon
episodes.description: Supergirl and Mon-El find a remnant of Krypton drifting deep in space. Meanwhile, Alex faces a killer from her past, and Winn ends up babysitting Ruby.

episodes.title: Not Kansas
episodes.description: Kara and Mon-El return to Argo City, but not all is as it seems. Meanwhile, in Supergirl's absence, Guardian and the DEO deal with a dangerous gunman wielding DEO weaponry.

episodes.title: Make It Reign
episodes.description: Supergirl and Mon-El try to get to Earth to stop the Daughters of Juru from resurrecting Reign and triggering Earth's destruction. Meanwhile, Hank participates in The Reach with his father, and Ruby demands the truth from Sam.

episodes.title: Battles Lost and Won
episodes.description: The heroes must come up with a way to defeat Reign without killing her. Afterward, Winn and Alex get job offers, Mon-El and Hank make decisions about their personal lives, and James has a news story for the world.

episodes.title: Nora
episodes.description: After Nora meets her parents and reveals that she's stuck in 2018, Flash goes off after a new meta--Gridlock--and subsequently discovers what happens to himself in the future.

episodes.title: The Book of Consequences: Chapter One: Rise of the Green Light Babies
episodes.description: Months after the ASA's attack, Jeff and his family discover that things are worse than ever. Green Light babies are rampant in the street, the board is threatening to shut down Garfield, an ASA agent is probing into Lynn's involvement with the pods, and Anissa's powers are going out of control.

episodes.title: The American Alien
episodes.description: With Superman off-world, Supergirl becomes a worldwide beacon of hope. Meanwhile, Lena takes secret measures to keep James out of prison, while Kara welcomes a new reporter to CatCo and Alex and Brainiac-5 get off to a rocky start after the latter takes Winn's position at the DEO.

episodes.title: Inmate 4587
episodes.description: In prison, Oliver tries to keep his head down and serve out his time so he can be reunited with his family. Felicity and William are in witness protection, Laurel is the city's new mayor, Rene is teaching boxing, Diggle and Curtis are working at ARGUS, and Dinah is the new police chief. While Dragon tracks down Oliver's loved one, a new vigilante calling himself Green Arrow fights the criminals of Star City.

episodes.title: Blocked
episodes.description: The team take on a new meta with the ability to create blocks out of concentrated air. Meanwhile, Danielle realizes that she's losing her powers, Barry tries to deal with an overeager Nora, Cisco deals with the loss of Gypsy, and Caitlin wonders whether to track down her father.

episodes.title: The Book of Consequences: Chapter Two: Black Jesus Blues
episodes.description: One of the Green Light Babies escapes her pod and goes on a rampage. Meanwhile, Jeff is informed that he has been replaced as principal, Anissa reconnects with Grace, and Khalil pays Jennifer a visit.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.description: The U.S. people are shaken by the revelation that the President is an alien. As Supergirl tries to quell the unrest, Nia tells James that he should write an editorial supporting aliens. Meanwhile, Mercy launches an attack on L-Corp to shut down the image inducers and reveal the aliens for who they really are.

episodes.title: The Longbow Hunters
episodes.description: Diaz hires the Longbow Hunters to help him steal an ARGUS weapon. Felicity and Diggle fight over how to deal with the thieves, while in prison, Oliver finds that he has to pay a price to get the information he needs from Brick.

episodes.title: The Virgin Gary
episodes.description: After four months of returning the remaining anachronisms to their correct times, the Legends are ready for a break. But Constantine soon arrives with warnings of dark deeds, and the team is off to Woodstock to deal with a deceptively magical menace.

episodes.title: The Death of Vibe
episodes.description: While Caitlin and Ralph look into Thomas Snow's death, the others deal with Cicada and bring in a consulting detective to help them.

episodes.title: The Book of Consequences: Chapter Three: Master Lowry
episodes.description: Jeff cleans out his desk after the board retires him as principal. Meanwhile, Anissa goes looking for money to keep Holt's clinic from going insolvent, Lynn gets a new co-worker, and Jennifer meets a woman with a unique gift.

episodes.title: Man of Steel
episodes.description: While the DEO try to save Supergirl's life, the events leading up to the creation of Agent Liberty are shown.

episodes.title: Crossing Lines
episodes.description: Brick promises Oliver that an informer named the Demon has the information that Oliver wants... if Oliver can get to him. In Star City Felicity goes to Watson and demands her help bringing Diaz to justice, while Diaz and the Longbow Hunters invade the CDC.

episodes.title: Witch Hunt
episodes.description: The Legends travel to Salem 1692 to investigate a magical disturbance during the Witch Trials. Meanwhile, Nate stays in DC to try and reconnect with his father but it doesn't go so well.

episodes.title: News Flash
episodes.description: Nora reveals what Iris did to her in the future that causes her to be so hostile to her in the present. Ralph and Sherloque try to trace Cicada, and Team Flash faces someone with the ability to control minds.

episodes.title: The Book of Consequences: Chapter Four: Translucent Freak
episodes.description: While Tobias scheme to clear himself of any suspicion of Alvin's death, Jeff has it out with Anissa, Jennifer, Bill, and Lowry.

episodes.title: Ahimsa
episodes.description: To heal Supergirl, Alex assigns Brainiac-5 and Lena to find a way to remove the Kryptonite from Earth's atmosphere. Meanwhile, Mercy and Otis abduct aliens from a DEO facility and use them to attack children and spread fear, and Hank meets an ally in his fight.

episodes.title: Level Two
episodes.description: A prison psychiatrist pays Oliver a visit. Meanwhile, Rene convinces Dinah to let him help her investigate a series of fires in the Glades, and Laurel warns Felicity about embrainc the darkness. In the future, William and Roy learn more about what's happening in Star City and meet a member of the Vigilante Resistance.

episodes.title: Dancing Queen
episodes.description: The Legends travel to London 1977 where Ray has to infiltrate a punk rock band to find a magical creature. Constantine pays a visit to his parents, while Nate deals with his first field assignment at the Time Bureau.

episodes.title: Parasite Lost
episodes.description: When Jensen--the new Parasite--attacks aliens, Supergirl is forced to take to the sidelines rather than give him further power. As a result, Kara writes an article on an alien healer who makes him a target. Meanwhile, Alex learns some surprising things about her new superior, and James comes to a realization about the Children of Liberty and their anti-alien agenda.

episodes.title: The Demon
episodes.description: Felicity discovers that Oliver's visitation rights have been revoked, while Oliver meets an old friend on Level Two and forms an alliance. Meanwhile, Curtis has second thoughts about going out into the field as an ARGUS undercover operative, and Laurel and Dinah join forces to help Felicity.

episodes.title: Wet Hot American Bummer
episodes.description: When Gideon detects a magical event at a summer camp in 1995, Sara, Ava, Constantine, and Ray pose as camp counselors to investigate the mystery. Meanwhile, Mick has a heart-to-heart with the imprisoned Charlie.

episodes.title: All Doll'd Up
episodes.description: A new meta launches an attack on Central City, and Flash tries to deal with him while Nora avoids Iris. Meanwhile, Cisco, Caitlin, Sherloque, and Ralph try to track down Caitlin's father Thomas.

episodes.title: The Book of Blood: Chapter One: Requiem
episodes.description: Death strikes close to home for the Pierce family, and Jeff has trouble coping. Jace offers Lynn a solution to saving the Green Light babies, and a new threat emerges in South Freeland.

episodes.title: Call to Action
episodes.description: As the Thanksgiving holiday approaches, the Children of Liberty prepare a new initiative to wipe out the aliens among them. James and Lena have their first major argument, and Nia displays narcolepsy but refuses help.

episodes.title: Due Process
episodes.description: While Laurel tries to get Oliver released from prison, Felicity and the others join forces to capture Diaz... with help from the new Green Arrow. In the future, William and the others get a glimpse of Felicity's plans for Star City.

episodes.title: Tagumo Attacks!!!
episodes.description: When Gideon picks up a magical disturbance in Tokyo 1951, Sara, Zari, and Mick head there and take Charlie along to earn her keep. Meanwhile, Nate deals with true monsters when he has Thanksgiving dinner with his family, and Ray asks Nora to help Constantine.

episodes.title: The Icicle Cometh
episodes.description: Caitlin is reunited with her long-lost father, but Cisco suspects that not everything is at it seems. Ralph teams up with Cecile to learn who was injured the night of the Enlightenment by the satellite crash, and Iris, Nora, and Sherloque try to track down the core piece of the satellite.

episodes.title: The Book of Blood: Chapter Two: The Perdi
episodes.description: While Lynn deals with the aftermath of fourteen deaths, Anissa meets with Anaya's parents and help her deliver her baby... only to receive a surprise.

episodes.title: Rather the Fallen Angel
episodes.description: Hank assures Supergirl that Manchester is a trustworthy ally. Meanwhile, James meets with Agent Liberty and has to choose between betraying his reputation or committing an act of terrorism for the Children of Liberty.

episodes.title: The Slabside Redemption
episodes.description: Diaz enters Slabside and takes control of the place, releasing the inmates. Oliver must team up with an old enemy to stop him.

episodes.title: Tender is the Nate
episodes.description: Hank joins the Legends on a fact-finding mission to see why they cost so much, and Nate tags along. Meanwhile, Mona begins her new job at the Time Bureau, and ends up trapped with Ava and Nora.

episodes.title: O Come, All Ye Thankful
episodes.description: A new weather-wielding villain appears in Central City, and demands that Team Flash hands Mark Mardon over to her. Nora reveals her unresolved feelings for losing Barry in the future, and the origin of Cicada is revealed.

episodes.title: The Book of Blood: Chapter Three: The Sange
episodes.description: Looker and her Sange search for Anaya's after electrocuting a captive Jeff. Their mistake. Meanwhile, Jennifer and Khalil come up with a short-term plan to get Holt out of harm's way, but Holt isn't interested in cooperating.

episodes.title: Bunker Hill
episodes.description: Manchester learns Agent Liberty's secret identity and goes to obtain vengeance for Fiona's death. Nia has a prophetic dream, and Kara and Brainiac-5 help her to avoid the future that she has foreseen.

episodes.title: Unmasked
episodes.description: Oliver reaccustoms himself to life out of prison, while a killer posing as the new Green Arrow kills two men. Meanwhile, Diggle and Lyle discover a secret terrorist backer and turned to an unexpected ally.

episodes.title: Hell No, Dolly!
episodes.description: The Legends learn of a Fugitive serial killer in 1838 New Orleans. However, when they arrive, the city stirs up memories in Constantine of his greatest love... and his greatest betrayal. While the team hunt down the serial killer, Constantine tries to alter history with unexpected results.

episodes.title: What's Past Is Prologue
episodes.description: To defeat Cicada, Nora comes up with a plan to assemble the necessary components from discarded villain items in the past and hide them in the present. Barry travels back in time to recover the three components, and reluctantly takes Nora with him.

episodes.title: The Book of Rebellion: Chapter One: Exodus
episodes.description: Jeff reveals to Lynn and Anissa that Peter is still alive, and together they go searching for Jennifer and Khalil. Meanwhile, Tobias brings in an old "friend" to hunt down Khalil, who catches up to Khalil at the same time that Black Lightning does.

episodes.title: Elseworlds, Part 1
episodes.description: Oliver and Barry discover that they've swapped bodies. To find someone who can recognize them for who they are, they travel to Earth-38 to get Kara's help. Before they can solve the mystery of the mind-swap, the heroes have to take down a new menace: AMAZO, a robot with all of their powers.

episodes.title: Elseworlds, Part 2
episodes.description: Barry, Oliver, and Kara travel to Gotham City to try to find Deagan, and meet the city's new protector while discovering that Bruce Wayne has vanished. Meanwhile, a Flash from another world arrives to warn the heroes of what they face and who is responsible.

episodes.title: Legends of To-Meow-Meow
episodes.description: After Constantine alters the timeline, he, Zari, and Charlie try to put right what once went wrong but end up making things worse.

episodes.title: Elseworlds, Part 3
episodes.description: Deegan "thinks big" and rewrites the reality of Earth-1 so that he's the only superhero... and a familiar face. While Barry and Oliver try to contact Superman on Earth-38, Kara tries to get through to her foster sister Alex... who no longer remembers who Kara is.

episodes.title: The Book of Rebellion: Chapter Two: Gift of the Magi
episodes.description: Jennifer breaks into a hospital supply room to get the antibiotics she needs for Khalil when he becomes feverish from his injury. While Cutter tracks her, Black Lightning, Thunder, and Peter try to find the missing teenagers while Lynn approaches Khalil's estranged father.

episodes.title: The Flash & The Furious
episodes.description: When a new meta-tech villain--Silver Ghost--helps Jocelyn Jackam escape, Nora wonders if Jocelyn wants to reform as she claims. Meanwhile, Barry is forced to stay in the pipeline after a confrontation with Silver Ghost, and Cisco discovers a possible meta-human cure.

episodes.title: Suspicious Minds
episodes.description: Supergirl finds a ship full of dead SEAL soldiers, and discovers that it's connected to Haley and the US government. Brainiac-5 sets up a meeting—at a romantic restaurant—with Nia to discuss her future as a possible superhero, and Lena tells James what she's been working on.

episodes.title: My Name is Emiko Queen
episodes.description: Emiko goes hunting for the man who killed her mother, and gets a new partner. Meanwhile, Oliver learns about the half-sister he never knew he had, and Diggle makes Diaz a deal in return for Dante's whereabouts.

episodes.title: The Book of Rebellion: Chapter Three: Angelitos Negros
episodes.description: Jennifer decides that it's time to stop running, and Jeff asks Bill for a favor. Tobias reveals to Todd why he's supporting him financially, and Todd learns of a secret that is the key to Tobias controlling Freeland.

episodes.title: Seeing Red
episodes.description: Cicada renews his murder spree against metas and cripples XS, causing Flash to lose control. Meanwhile, Killer Frost worries that she'll be destroyed by the cure Caitlin is working on, and Sherloque continues trying to unravel the mystery behind Nora's journal.

episodes.title: Blood Memory
episodes.description: Kara travels with Nia to the latter's hometown and discovers that Nia is inheriting the Dreamer power from her mother... which has skipped Nia's sister Maeve. In National City, an outbreak of a new drug rage starts and Alex investigates while asking J'onn to determine if she's having memory problems.

episodes.title: Past Sins
episodes.description: Oliver and Laurel go on TV for an interview and end up making themselves targets of two separate individuals. At ARGUS, Curtis has objections to the Ghost Initiative program when Diggle and Lyla order him to monitor the bombs in the members' heads.

episodes.title: The Book of Secrets: Chapter One: Prodigal Son
episodes.description: While the Pierces gather around a dying Khalil, Tobias discovers that Jace knows where the Masters of Disasters are and breaks her out of ASA custody.

episodes.title: Memorabilia
episodes.description: Sherloque uses a memory machine to try and revive Grace, and Nora ends up trapped in the girl's memories. Barry and Iris go in to save their daughter, and see her memories of a future Iris. Meanwhile, Ralph tricks Cisco into a night out.

episodes.title: Emerald Archer
episodes.description: Oliver gives a documentary team access to him and his family as part of his new transparency, and they probe into every corner of his life--and the lives of other vigilantes in Star City--as a vigilante mask-killer shows up.

episodes.title: The Book of Secrets: Chapter Two: Just and Unjust
episodes.description: Jennifer grieves in the aftermath of Khalil's death, and Odell saves Lynn from an abduction. At Garfield, Jennifer and Jeff both confront Lowry, while Anissa is surprised by a sudden turn of events with Grace.

episodes.title: Goldfaced
episodes.description: To find a device that will let them administer the meta cure to Cicada, Barry and Ralph go undercover to get it from a black market arms dealer. Meanwhile, Iris decides to go looking for Cicada on her own, and Sherloque meets a woman after his own heart.

episodes.title: Star City Slayer
episodes.description: The Star City Slayer claims another victim, and Dinah reaches out to Captain Singh in Central City for information. William calls his grandparents, and Curtis comes to a decision about his future career.

episodes.title: The Book of Secrets: Chapter Three: Pillar of Fire
episodes.description: Tobias activates one of the Masters of Disaster, and sends him and Cutter to bring him the other pods. Napier gets Jeff a chance to get his old job back, and Anissa learns more about Grace's history.

episodes.title: Cause and XS
episodes.description: With Barry out of contact in the Speed Force, XS witnesses Cicada kill Killer Frost and tries to travel back in time to stop the outcome... and a different teammate dies with her every attempt.

episodes.title: Menagerie
episodes.description: Kara continues to deal with the fallout from Alex's mindwipe, and a new villain enters National City: Menagerie, a human jewel thief merged with an alien symbiote. Nia invites Brainiac-5 to her Valentine's Day party, and Ben reaches out to his wife and son.

episodes.title: What's So Funny About Truth, Justice, and the American Way?
episodes.description: Manchester assembles a team of Supergirl's old and new opponents to break him out of prison and form The Elite. Meanwhile, President Baker reaches out to Ben and soon asks him for more than photo ops.

episodes.title: Brothers & Sisters
episodes.description: Diggle, Lyla, and the Ghost Initiative close in on Dante, but they soon discover that there are traitors among them. Oliver reaches out to Emiko, and in the future William reaches out to Mia.

episodes.title: The Book of Secrets: Chapter Four: Original Sin
episodes.description: Jeff receives a visit from a former student, Anissa goes looking for Grace, and Jennifer gets a new suit.

episodes.title: King Shark vs. Gorilla Grodd
episodes.description: The team need a meta to test the cure on, and settle on King Shark. Grodd escapes from ARGUS captivity and initiates his own plan to rule Central City... and then the world.

episodes.title: Stand and Deliver
episodes.description: Ben proposes to end the Alien Amnesty Act and holds a rally. Alien protesters hold a peaceful march, but Manchester plans to disrupt the event using stolen Kryptonian technology... and reveal J'onn's true feelings. James goes to the rally to cover events as a photographer.

episodes.title: Training Day
episodes.description: Oliver and the team attempt to work for the SCPD following their procedure, but find them overly restrictive compared to what they're accustomed to. In the future, William and Mia work together to find a way to listen to the audio cassette.

episodes.title: The Book of the Apocalypse: Chapter One: The Alpha
episodes.description: Tobias initiates the first step in selling his army of metas, Jeff sets down some ground rules to his daughters, and Lala and Lazarus have a chat.

episodes.title: Failure Is an Orphan
episodes.description: Barry tries to find the words to convince Cicada to take the cure that Team Flash has developed. Joe and Cecile join forces to question Ambres, and Eobard warns Nora that a new timeline is coming.

episodes.title: O Brother, Where Art Thou?
episodes.description: James undergoes surgery to replace his shattered spine, and Lena has no choice but to work with her brother Lex to perfect the Harun-El serum to cure James before he dies. J'onn and Kara track down Manchester, who has recovered the Staff of H'ronmeer and attempts to turn J'onn from the path of peace.

episodes.title: Star City 2040
episodes.description: In 2040, the team discover that Galaxy One is a cover for Eden Corps and that the company plans to blow up Star City. William and Mia find Felicity, and Rene decides which side that he's on.

episodes.title: The Book of the Apocalypse: Chapter Two: The Omega
episodes.description: Black Lightning and Thunder take on the Masters of Disaster, while Peter and Jennifer try to restore the city's power during the riots that break out after Cape Guy's death. Tobias and Cutter have a disagreement, and Odell makes his move.

episodes.title: Time Bomb
episodes.description: Team Flash discovers the nature of the new Cicada when they find a time sphere that is a future duplicate of Eobard's. They also find out that Cicada II is going after the meta that she believes killed her parents, while Sherloque reaches the conclusion of his investigation.

episodes.title: The House of L
episodes.description: Lex spends three years plotting his next scheme, working with the Kaznian government to train the Supergirl clone to further their ambitions against America so that he can step in and stop them, becoming a hero to the world and its savior.

episodes.title: Inheritance
episodes.description: Oliver learns that Emiko is concealing things from him, and tries to redeem her. The team faces a new threat--the Ninth Circle--while Laurel tries to get testimony from a reluctant witness.

episodes.title: All About Eve
episodes.description: J'onn has a meeting with his deceased father, while Supergirl, Alex, and Lena join forces to track down Eve and locate Lex.

episodes.title: Lucha De Apuestas
episodes.description: Koname makes his way to Mexico City 1961 and becomes a masked luchador, El Lobo. The Legends track him there and try to recover him, and realize that Mona was telling the truth about the Men in Black who tried to abduct the Kaupe. Meanwhile, Ava chooses sides when Sara asks for her support.

episodes.title: The Getaway
episodes.description: When President Nixon starts telling the truth non-stop in 1973, the Legends suspect magical involvement and travel there to learn what's going on. The Time Bureau is hot on their trail, and the team takes to the road in an RV when Hank and his people close in.

episodes.title: Séance and Sensibility
episodes.description: While Nate attends Hank's wake, Constantine tries to summon Hank's spirit with some help from Mick. Meanwhile, the other Legends travel to 1802 England when Jane Austen's works start disappearing from the timeline.

episodes.title: Lost Canary
episodes.description: Laurel reverts to her Black Siren ways and teams up with a new partner, Shadow Thief. Dinah puts out an arrest warrant on Laurel, but Felicity isn't convinced her friend is beyond redemption and calls in another friend to help. Meanwhile, Oliver and Spartan set out to learn who had Emiko's mother killed.

episodes.title: Godspeed
episodes.description: To learn why Nora joined forces with Eobard, Team Flash reads her journal. They discover that in 2049, Eobard was the only person who was honest with Nora, and taught her how to use her powers.

episodes.title: Crime and Punishment
episodes.description: Supergirl and Lena go to Stryker's Island to check out Lex's cell, and find a clue to his schemes. Supergirl is declared a criminal and is forced to question whether she does more harm or good, while James deals with the fallout from being injected with the serum.

episodes.title: The Eggplant, the Witch & the Wardrobe
episodes.description: Sara, Nora, and Constantine find a missing Ava, and Sara enters her lover's purgatory when they discover Neron has removed her soul. Zari considers her relationship with Nate, and Nate finds out more about the theme park Hank had planned.

episodes.title: Spartan
episodes.description: After the Ninth Circle steals valuable data, Diggle is forced to turn to his stepfather for help... and he blames the man for the death of his biological father. In the future, Felicity, Mia and Connor learn the extent of Galaxy One's plans.

episodes.title: Snow Pack
episodes.description: Iris and Ralph travel to the future to find Nora and confront Eobard, while Barry, Joe, and Sherloque deal with Icicle's newest scheme.

episodes.title: American Dreamer
episodes.description: Kara tries to convince an Amertek insider to provide her with information proving a connection to Lex. Dreamer agrees to a TV interview, and Brainiac-5 helps James explore the cause of his PTSD.

episodes.title: Egg MacGuffin
episodes.description: Sara sends Nate and Zari on an "easy" mission to 1933 to recover a mysterious golden egg, while she and Ava have book club. Charlie and Mick go to Romanti-Con to make $20,000 off of Charlie pretending to be Mick's writer's psuedonym "Rebecca Silver", while Ray convinces an unlikely ally to help free him from Neron's grasp.

episodes.title: Confessions
episodes.description: Two transit guards are murdered at the scene of a Team Arrow operation, and Dinah tries to determine the truth about who killed them.

episodes.title: Gone Rogue
episodes.description: Back from the future, Nora gathers a group of Rogues to steal meta-tech. Meanwhile, Cicada II steals Cisco's metahuman cure, and Barry considers whether he's a good parent.

episodes.title: Will the Real Miss Tessmacher Please Stand Up?
episodes.description: Kara and Lena track Lex to Kaznia, and find Eve but no Lex. Ben abandons his son to go after his wife's killer, which pits him against Brainiac-5, Dreamer, and the newly superpowered James. Alex and Kelly travel to meet with a woman giving birth to a child who could become Alex's.

episodes.title: Nip | Stuck
episodes.description: Neron traps the Legends in the Ice Age, and then tries to convince Constantine to open a stable portal to Hell by showing him his ancestor. Gary takes control of the Bureau and holds performance reviews to convince everyone that he's just the man they need.

episodes.title: Living Proof
episodes.description: Emiko's plans for Star City continue: Oliver is trapped, the team is wanted by the police, and Felicity is on the run.

episodes.title: The Girl with the Red Lightning
episodes.description: Cicada II assembles the part to build an atomizer that will release the meta-human killing virus, and Nora tries to use her psychic connection to the villain to find out what she's going to do next despite the risk.

episodes.title: Red Dawn
